scope: Overlay of all 97 B22 historical research records. Does not modify B22 or legacy acquisition decisions. CI-checked releases are source-scoped; this is not proof of every text's complete original-print transcription, rights clearance, or UI interaction.
sourceWarnings: Historical acquisition rows, live canonical prayers, novena programs, source witness identities, and contextual readers overlap; never add their counts as unique published prayers.
EXISTING_OWNER confirms an owner, not a certification of exact historic wording, reader visibility, rights or complete print collation.
INTENT_ONLY_NOT_TEXT means the user purpose is met; exact candidate wording is NOT imported.
RELEASED_POST_B22 means a source-scoped implementation exists in another source edition/format; it does NOT assert the named original modern source was copied verbatim.
AO-AQ-047 is source held for the SHORT Precious Blood chaplet; the source-distinct full form is published and must not be silently substituted.
B22 remains immutable as a historical 2026-10-28 decision record, and the 94-row ownership foundation is not a corpus of 94 unique prayers.
ICRSP/ICKSP selected-source PR #1800 is still open/draft and not 25 new published prayers.
No additional content was released by this ledger overlay.
